newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST - Metrobank 1996 net seen up 41 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Metrobank 1996 net seen up 41 pct.

text.p: Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co (Metrobank), the country's biggest bank in terms of capital, could post a 41 percent rise in net profit to 4.945 billion pesos from 3.502 billion pesos in 1995, a Reuters poll showed.
In the first nine months of 1996, the bank's net profit rose 39.5 percent to 3.189 billion from 2.286 billion pesos in the 1995 period.
The poll of six brokerage houses completed on Friday showed analysts expected the bank's 1997 net to rise further by 30 percent to an average 6.419 billion pesos.

The bank's earnings would be boosted by a buoyant economy as well as a one percentage point cut in reserve requirements which came into effect this month and another one percentage point cut to be implemented in July, analysts said.
The cuts are expected to provide additional liquidity of 13.4 billion pesos which could be used by banks to meet rising demand for loans, they said.
Brokers who contributed to the poll were Abacus Securities, All Asia Securities, Angping Securities, Philippine Asia Equity, DBP-Daiwa Securities and ING-Barings Securities.
